payload.definition: A versioned operator-owned binding from a public model offering to a numeric loopback HTTP endpoint and explicit upstream authentication mode.
payload.plain_explanation: A versioned operator-owned binding from a public model offering to a numeric loopback HTTP endpoint and explicit upstream authentication mode.
payload.boundary: It selects execution location; it does not grant caller access or choose model weights.

payload.definition: A versioned text-generation wire contract with messages/model/max_tokens/stream input, answer/stop_reason JSON output, and named JSON SSE delta/completed/error events.
payload.plain_explanation: A versioned text-generation wire contract with messages/model/max_tokens/stream input, answer/stop_reason JSON output, and named JSON SSE delta/completed/error events.
payload.boundary: It is our canonical local protocol; compatibility with third-party engines must be demonstrated.

payload.definition: An operator-attested upper bound on input tokens for every valid request and every engine in a catalog, combined with requested output tokens for eligibility.
payload.plain_explanation: An operator-attested upper bound on input tokens for every valid request and every engine in a catalog, combined with requested output tokens for eligibility.
payload.boundary: It is not exact token usage or a universally valid tokenizer estimate.
